related_questions.question: How many years do you have to work for NY state to get a pension?

text_blocks.snippet: To qualify for a New York State pension, you need at least five years of credited service. This is known as vesting. However, to receive the full retirement benefit, you generally need to be at least 62 years old or have 30 years of service, which allows for retirement as early as 55 with a reduced benefit.
snippet_highlighted_words: at least five years of credited service

list.title: Vesting:
list.snippet: You become vested (eligible for a pension) after five years of service. This is automatic and doesn't require any specific paperwork.

list.title: Service Retirement:
list.snippet: To receive the full retirement benefit, you generally need to be at least 62 years old.

list.title: Early Retirement:
list.snippet: You can retire as early as 55 with less than 30 years of service, but your benefit will be reduced.

list.title: Full Retirement Benefit:
list.snippet: With 30 years of service, you can retire at 55 with an unreduced benefit.

related_questions.question: How do I check my NYS retirement?

text_blocks.snippet: To check your NYS retirement information, sign in to Retirement Online. Within your account, you can view your Member Annual Statement, pension check details, and manage other aspects of your retirement account.

list.title: 1. Sign in to Retirement Online:
list.snippet: Go to the Retirement Online portal and sign in with your username and password.

list.title: 2. View Member Annual Statement:
list.snippet: Look for the "My Account Summary" section and click on the "View My Member Annual Statement" button. If the Retirement System is blank, you may need to select it from the Look Up icon.

list.title: 3. Access Pension Check Information:
list.snippet: To view your pension payment details, navigate to the "View Pension Check" option.

list.title: 4. Update Contact Information:
list.snippet: Ensure your contact information is up-to-date within Retirement Online, especially your mailing and email addresses, to receive important notifications and statements.

list.title: 5. Explore Other Features:
list.snippet: Retirement Online provides various other services, including the ability to estimate your pension, apply for loans, and manage your service credit.

text_blocks.snippet: By using Retirement Online, you can efficiently manage your NYS retirement information and stay informed about your benefits.
